description: The Maharashtra government is implementing Sarvam AI's Indus platform across various departments, empowering 2,500 officials to streamline administrative tasks using artificial intelligence.
body_lead: Maharashtra to deploy sovereign AI across state departments, 2,500 officials to use Sarvam's Indus The Maharashtra government has approved the deployment of Indus, Sarvam AI's sovereign AI workspace, across state government departments, with around 2,500 officials set to use the platform in their daily work.
